name: isadek-office-mobile
description: Isadek Office for Android and iOS (Capacitor), built from the same pages as the desktop app.

scripts.android: npm run build && node scripts/add-platform.js android && npx cap sync android
scripts.ios: npm run build && node scripts/add-platform.js ios && npx cap sync ios
scripts.apk: npm run android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
